comment: UI performance and memory budgets (docs/architecture/ui-style-and-feedback-spec.md sections 4.10, 11; ui-and-controls-spec.md section 9; m3-build-spec.md section 8; m4-build-spec.md section 8; m4-5-build-spec.md section 8). Read by tools/ui/perf_ui.gd. Never read by a GUT test.

screen_push_cpu_worst_ms.what: worst cold instantiate + ScreenStack.push time across M1.5 screens

screen_push_worst_ms.what: worst first-frame push + render time across M1.5 screens, second (warm) push

screen_push_cold_worst_ms.what: worst first-ever push + render across M1.5 screens: a hitch over this is a bug (target 50)

hud_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame with HUD + HexPanel open at 1920x1080

minimap_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame with the HUD and the minimap in a country game (Genoa) at 1920x1080 (M2)

pick_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame with the country pick open at 1920x1080 (M2)

report_push_ms.what: the season report's first-frame push + render with the nine-section fixture at 1920x1080 (M3)

save_load_push_ms.what: worst first-frame push + render of Save and Load with 12 saved rows, Save and Load tabs (M3)

log_open_ms.what: opening the action log with two seasons of lines, first drawn frame (M3)

works_card_push_ms.what: the works card's push (the call and one forced draw), warm, worst of 3, in a Genoa game at 1920x1080 (M4)

study_push_ms.what: the Statesman's Study's push (the call and one forced draw), warm, worst of 3, Economy page, 1920x1080 (M4)

chips_refresh_ms.what: mean CPU time of Chips.refresh (both cards rebuilt) over 30 runs (M4)

marks_show_ms.what: mean CPU time of the map marks' show (the ghost, tint and labels of the vineyard card) over 30 runs (M4)

ribbons_16_frame_ms.what: mean CPU time a frame of Floaters.advance with 16 live ribbons (M3)

season_fade_capture_ms.what: the season fade's capture frame on the owner's Mac; enforced with --gpu-limits (M3)

study_open_cold_ms.what: the worst of the five M4.5 pages and tabs (Districts, Goods, History tab, Rankings, History) opened with the view cache cleared, north Italy after 40 seasons, the call and one forced draw (M4.5)

study_open_europe_ms.what: the same five on the made-up Europe as its largest country after the warmer ran; skipped headless (M4.5)

study_tab_switch_ms.what: Ctrl+] between two tabs of Economy already built, the call and one forced draw (M4.5)

yields_mode_ms.what: key 4 to the first Yields frame, north Italy, the view cache cleared (M4.5)

yields_update_ms.what: a work begun in Yields: yield_bytes warm plus update_yields of one changed byte, mean of 30 (M4.5)

study_table_rows_ms.what: StudyTable.set_rows with 100 rows of 7 columns, two custom-drawn, worst of 5 (M4.5)

timeline_draw_ms.what: TimelineStrip._draw with 680 seasons and 200 marks, worst of 5 (M4.5)

kit_1x_mb.what: 1x Studiolo UI kit RGBA8 memory in play (budget < 4 MB)

kit_2x_mb.what: 2x Studiolo UI kit RGBA8 memory in play (budget < 16 MB)
